s:okinawa/shuri-castle: The Seiden main hall of Shuri Castle: a vivid red-lacquered wooden palace with ornate golden dragon details and a curved red-tiled roof, facing the broad stone courtyard with red and white striped paving, clear blue sky, bright tropical sunlight.
s:okinawa/kokusai-dori: Inside the Makishi Public Market: a bright ground-floor hall of fish stalls with trays of tropical fish in vivid blue, red and green, lobsters and shellfish on crushed ice, small distant shoppers, warm indoor light.
s:okinawa/sefa-utaki: Sangui at Sefa-utaki: two enormous leaning limestone rocks forming a tall triangular passage, lush tropical ferns and vines around, a stone path leading through, sunlight filtering in, a glimpse of blue sea beyond, quiet, no people.
s:okinawa/churaumi-aquarium: The Kuroshio Sea tank at Churaumi Aquarium: a huge deep-blue acrylic window with a whale shark and giant manta rays gliding past schools of silver fish, shafts of light from above, small silhouettes of visitors along the bottom of the frame.
s:okinawa/kouri-island: Kouri Bridge seen from above: a long low bridge crossing vivid turquoise and pale aqua shallow sea with white sand shoals toward green Kouri Island, clear blue sky, bright midday summer sunlight, small cars on the bridge.
s:okinawa/manzamo: Cape Manzamo: a flat grassy coral limestone plateau ending in a sheer cliff shaped like an elephant's trunk dipping into the sea, the water shifting from turquoise to deep cobalt, late-afternoon golden light, clear sky.
s:okinawa/nakijin-castle: Nakijin Castle ruins in late January: grey limestone walls winding in long sinuous curves along the ridge, deep pink kanhi-zakura cherry blossoms in front of the stone gate, the distant blue East China Sea, clear sky, soft afternoon light.
s:okinawa/kabira-bay: Kabira Bay on Ishigaki from the hilltop viewpoint: layers of emerald, turquoise and cobalt water, small green islets, a white sand beach, a few glass-bottom boats moored near shore, bright midday sunlight, clear sky.
s:okinawa/taketomi-island: A white coral-sand lane on Taketomi Island: single-storey houses with red-tiled roofs bonded with white mortar and small shisa figures on top, low grey coral-stone walls with hibiscus and bougainvillea, a water buffalo cart in the distance, bright sunshine.
s:okinawa/yonaha-maehama: Yonaha Maehama Beach on Miyakojima: a long, wide, powder-white sand beach curving along shallow, crystal-clear, glowing turquoise water, the low Kurima Bridge in the far distance, clear blue sky, bright midday sunlight.
f:okinawa/okinawa-soba: A bowl of Okinawa soba: thick, flat wheat noodles in clear pork-and-bonito broth, topped with slices of glazed braised pork belly, fish cake, chopped green onion and red pickled ginger, a small glass bottle of chilli-infused awamori beside, 45-degree angle, natural light.
f:okinawa/goya-champuru: Goya champuru: stir-fried bright green bitter melon slices with tofu, scrambled egg and slices of luncheon meat, sprinkled with bonito flakes, on a ceramic plate on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:okinawa/taco-rice: Okinawan taco rice: a plate of white rice topped with seasoned ground beef, shredded yellow cheese, shredded lettuce and diced tomato, a small dish of red salsa beside, on a casual diner table, 45-degree angle, bright natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:okinawa/agu-pork: Agu pork shabu-shabu: thin slices of Agu pork with thick white fat edges on a ceramic plate, a hot pot of simmering broth with greens beside, a dish of ponzu, on a dark wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:okinawa/sata-andagi: Freshly fried sata andagi: round golden-brown Okinawan doughnuts with cracked open tops, piled in a small basket lined with paper, one broken open showing a dense yellow crumb, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
